condition: An Enum whose member values are tuples gets serialized to a JSON array, and validating that JSON fails with an enum error because a list is not accepted as the tuple value.
workaround: Add a __get_pydantic_core_schema__ classmethod to the enum that wraps handler(source_type) in core_schema.no_info_before_validator_function. That function should convert non-member input to a tuple before validation.
